title: Command Center
subtitle: Local operating view into EVE's Company.OS read model. Marketing and CRM actions write local audit receipts only; dispatcher, auto-decompose, and external actions remain gated.

blocked.title: Read model unavailable
blocked.description: Start EVE through start_eve or set the Company.OS root so the app can read the local agent event ledger.
blocked.electronBridgeRequired: Command Center reads local Company.OS files through the Electron app process. This local bridge path is not available in browser WebUI mode.

errors.loadFailed: Command Center could not be loaded.

statusSurface.label: System state
statusSurface.description: Reads the public Command EVE status contract. No mutation, no Plane writes.
statusSurface.checkRequiredDescription: EVE could not fully prove the local status.

operatingSurfaces.description: The active operating surfaces are visible separately: local marketing work, local CRM, and the dispatch gate. Everything writes local receipts only until a gate allows real execution.

marketing.title: Marketing Lane
marketing.description: Create, move, comment on posts, and check NL-5 before worker dispatch.

crm.title: CRM Lane
crm.description: Prepare companies, contacts, and deals locally; customer data remains HG-4 gated.

dispatch.title: Dispatch Gate
dispatch.description: Shows whether a card dispatch was checked through NL-5 and Hermes remains blocked.

operatingReadiness.description: Proves local operability without silently enabling autonomy: marketing receipts, CRM NL-5 receipts, dispatch block, and worker lock must be visibly green.

marketingReceipts.title: Marketing receipts
marketingReceipts.description: Every local marketing card is linked to an append-only audit event.

crmNl5Receipts.title: CRM NL-5 receipts
crmNl5Receipts.description: CRM actions write local NL-5 receipts before customer data may later touch any execution path.

dispatchBlocked.title: Dispatch blocked before spawn
dispatchBlocked.description: The dispatch plan was checked through NL-5 and Hermes/worker execution stayed stopped.

workerAutonomyLocked.title: Worker autonomy locked
workerAutonomyLocked.description: Worker dispatch stays explicitly locked until controller and release gates allow real execution.

board.description: Board view from the same local read model. This overview stays read-only; local controls live in Marketing Board and CRM Overlay. No dispatcher, no auto-decompose.

marketingBoard.description: Hermes-native Kanban view for Command EVE Marketing. The app reads the local kanban.db, writes local cards and moves only with audit receipts, and checks dispatches through NL-5 before any worker could start.
marketingBoard.emptyColumn: No marketing cards in this lane.

blocked.title: Marketing Board not initialized yet
blocked.description: Hermes Kanban is ready, but the local marketing board database has not been created yet.

create.note: Creates exactly one local marketing card and one append-only audit event. No dispatcher, no auto-decompose, no workers.

dispatch.ready: Dispatch plan is ready, but still waits for controller approval.
dispatch.blocked: Dispatch was blocked before Hermes could spawn.
dispatch.approvalPanelDescription: The local handoff is prepared, but EVE will not start a worker until the controller explicitly approves this handoff.
dispatch.approvalRecordFailed: Controller review could not be recorded.

proof.note: Creates exactly one local proof card and one append-only audit event. No workers are started.

crmOverlay.description: Local CRM-ready sales overlay for companies, contacts, and deals. No cloud sync, no bulk imports, no outreach automation.
